svg.title: A-102 Second Floor & Roof Plan
svg.text: OPENABLE WINDOWS TO EAST BOUNDARY 0.70 / 1.10 / 1.10 m
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Block A is given over entirely to an open-air roof terrace
at this level, apart from the stair head and the light
2. Timber pergolas are set out on a 550 mm rafter pitch over
the lounge and the outdoor table; both are shown dashed as
they sit above the cut plane.
3. The studio suite is self-contained, with its own shower
room and kitchenette, and is entered from the stair head
without crossing the family floor below.
4. The studio cross ventilates between the light court on the
west and two east windows; the shower room has an openable
east window in place of mechanical extract. East boundary
openings are subject to local fire separation and rights
of light rules; confirm before construction.
5. Roof falls 1:60 to rainwater outlets at the parapet;
waterproofing turned up 150 mm minimum behind the terrace
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P2 2026-09-24 east windows, taller floors, garden on A-100
